m400418.良かった……。戦ってくださるのですね。\n流石はお人よし王じ……ゴホンゴホン。:
That's good… You're willing to fight.
As expected of a kind-hearted prince… *cough cough*

m400509.――王国近海にゴブリン軍団、ですか……。: ――Goblin hordes near the kingdom's coast, huh…
m400509.……捕縛が優先だ。\n犯罪者相手に犯罪をしてどうする。\nもちろんEXPもゴール: …Capturing them takes priority. What good is committing a crime against criminals? We won't get any EXP or gold anyway.
m400509.ああ。\n今朝から怪しい動きを見せている。: Yeah. They've been acting suspiciously since this morning.
m400509.うむ、私掠船団の協力は心強い。\n安心して敵戦力を削ることに集中できるな。: Yes, having the privateer fleet's support is reassuring. We can concentrate on cutting down enemy forces without worry.
m400509.うむ。\nなので潜水騎士に手伝ってもらって、\nゴブリン軍団の調査をしてみたとこ: Right. So we asked the Submarine Knights to help investigate the goblin horde, and—
m400509.ぐぬぬぬぬ。\n私掠船なのにー、王子クンの許可とってるのにー。: Grrr… Even though we're a privateer fleet—and have your permission, Prince…
m400509.ここは『大討伐ミッション』を発令し、\n一体でも多くの敵戦力を\n削る編成を重視: I recommend issuing a “Grand Annihilation Mission” and focusing on a lineup that whittles down as many enemy units as possible.
m400509.ここはこちらも軍を出し、\n明確に意志を問うべきでしょう。: We should also deploy troops and demand a clear answer.
m400509.そいつはよくないなぁ……。\n海であれ森であれ、\n漁場の所有権は王子クンにある: That's not good… Whether it's the sea or the forest, the fishing rights belong to you, Prince.
m400509.ただ、海上では普段と同じ効率での補給は望めない。\n出撃コストは回復しないから、: However, we can't expect the usual supply efficiency at sea. Since sortie costs don't recover, we should bring “Reinforcement Requests” and units like Valkyries.
m400509.つまり、ライフが０になってもクリアになるし、\n味方の被害は心配しなくていいって: In other words, even if our HP hits zero we still clear the stage, so you don't have to worry about friendly casualties!
m400509.で、相手が密漁ゴブリンだったら、\nもちろんお宝ぶん捕っていいんだよね？: So, if the opponents are poaching goblins, we can of course seize the treasure, right?
m400509.よし。編成は王子に任せる。\nただ、連中の頭数はかなりのものだ。: All right. I'll leave the formation to you, Prince. Just know they're a sizable force.
m400509.ゴブリンにはそういう文化がない可能性もある。\n正式に抗議して、それで聞いてくれ: Goblins might just not have that kind of culture. If a formal protest doesn't work, maybe we should give them a good blast?
m400509.ゴブリン軍団は物質界連合の一員ではありますが、\n未だ、解散後には敵対すると公言: Goblins are part of the Material Realm Alliance, but they've openly declared that they'll turn hostile after the dissolution—so they're a potential enemy force.
m400509.メカゴブリンクイーンの配下を騙る、\n別勢力のゴブリンである可能性もあります。: There's a chance these are goblins from another faction posing as Mecha-Goblin Queen's subordinates.
m400509.戦闘になっても、現場は私たちの縄張りだ。\n船団で囲んで、負傷者はしっかり回収す: Even once combat starts, this is still our territory. We'll encircle them with our fleet and make sure any wounded are properly rescued.
m400509.海上演習を王国領内でするつもりなら、\n正式に届け出をしろと伝えてみたが、\nこ: I told them that if they plan to conduct naval exercises within kingdom waters, they need to file an official report, but they keep insisting they're just anchored.
m400509.軍事行動と略奪を一緒にするな、まったく。\n――よし、それじゃあ各員出撃の準備を:
Don't mix combat with looting, honestly.
—Alright then, everyone, prepare to deploy.
The "Grand Subjugation Mission" begins!

m400582.――そろそろ、ハロウィンの祝祭が始まりますね。: ――It's about time the Halloween festivities begin.
m400582.――大変です王子！\n突如としてチェーンソーを振り回す怪物たちが現れ、\n仮装を:
――Prince, this is bad!
Monsters wielding chainsaws have suddenly appeared,
and they're rampaging through the venue along with the costumed villagers!!
m400582.――賑やかな声が聞こえると思ったら、\nもうハロウィンが始まっていたのかしら？:
I heard all that commotion and thought
the Halloween party had already started, hadn't it?
m400582.……まぁ、賑やかでいいと思いましょうか。: ……Well, I suppose the noise is good for the atmosphere.
m400582.……もしかしてだけど、\nさっきのは模擬戦ではなかったの……？:
...Wait, but,
was that not a sparring match just now...?
m400582.『大討伐ミッション』は、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒す事が目的です。:
The objective of a "Grand Cull Mission" is
to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400582.あ、ありがとうございますウィリアスさ……\nあんた洗脳されてるだろ！！:
Oh, thank you, Willias...!
You're brainwashed, aren't you?!
m400582.ああもう！ こうなりゃヤケだ！\nやるだけやってやんよぉぉぉ！！:
Ugh, fine! I'm done holding back!
I'm going to give it everything I've got!!
m400582.あっ、飾りといえばね、\n実はレミィとクーコも会場の準備を手伝ってくれたの！:
Oh, and speaking of decorations,
Remi and Kouko actually helped with the venue preparations too!
m400582.あの様子は精神支配されていますわ！\n村人たちが被っている仮面には、\n着けた者:
They appear to be under mental domination!
The masks the villagers are wearing
seem to have an effect that drives the wearer into a frenzy!
m400582.あれは……レミィさんとクーコさん！\n助かりました！ かの雷神の娘と風神の娘であ:
That's... Remii and Kuuko!
We're saved! With the daughter of the Thunder God and the daughter of the Wind God here, we've got the strength of a hundred men!
m400582.いいやまだよコレット！\nあっちがふたりなら、こっちもふたりでかかればいいわ！:
No, it's not, Colette!
If there are two of them over there, we'll just have two of us go at them!
m400582.いくぜェ！ ゴーストゾンビシャーク！！: Here I come! Ghost Zombie Shark!!
m400582.いけません！ チェインソン男が、\nハロウィンの力に飲まれ爆転しています！:
This is bad! Chainson Man is being
swallowed by the power of Halloween and transforming!
m400582.う、ぐっ、ぐぉぉぉーー！！\nチェーンソーが、暴れ回って……！？\nまずいっ、ハ:
Ugh... Grr... GAAAAH!!
The chainsaw is... going haywire...!?
This is bad! I'm being consumed by Halloween!
m400582.うぅ……俺たちは……いったい……？: Ugh... what... has happened... to us...?
m400582.うわっ、ふざけた言動に反して普通に強そうなのが\n腹立ちますね……！\nこれはち:
Ugh, it's infuriating that he looks
strong despite his ridiculous behavior...!
This might be tough...!
m400582.うん！ 任せてよチェインソン男くん！ （裏声）: Yes! Leave it to me, Chainson Man! (High-pitched voice)
m400582.え……。\n会場を直して、ハロウィンを楽しもう、ですか？:
Ehh...
Fix the venue and enjoy Halloween, is it?
m400582.ええっ！ じゃあ私たち、\n悪いことしちゃったんじゃ……！:
Ehh! Then we...
we did something bad, didn't we...!
m400582.お咎めなし、ですか。\nまったく、王子殿下は……。:
No punishment, is it.
Honestly, Your Highness...
m400582.これは、暴走……！？\n肉体が変形して、デーモンみたいになっていくわ！:
It's a rampage...!?
His body is mutating! He's turning into a demon!
m400582.させないぜッ！ 喰らえ！！\nデスハロウィン洗脳ビームッ！！:
I won't let you! Take this!!
Death Halloween Brainwashing Beam!!
m400582.すでに乱闘が起こって……。\nなんでただの村人の方も殺気立っているんですか！？:
A brawl has already broken out...
Why are the regular villagers getting so aggressive too?!
m400582.そういうことなら私もやるわ！\n折角作った飾りが壊れたままっていうのも悲しいもの:
If that's the case, I'll help too!
It's sad to leave the decorations we worked so hard on all broken!
m400582.そういえば、ちらっと見ましたけど、\nカボチャの飾りとか可愛くできてましたね。:
Speaking of which, I caught a glimpse earlier.
The pumpkin decorations you made were adorable.
m400582.そうは問屋とチェーンソーが卸さねェェ！\nギュイィィィィン！！\n俺たちの刃が回:
??? : Not so fast, you and your chainsaws!
Gyeeeeeein!!
Our blades are spinning up to full speed!!
m400582.だったら俺たちにも手伝わせてくれ！\nキエェェー！ 詫びハロウィン準備だァーー！:
Then let us help too!
Kieeeeee! It's time to prepare for the Apology Halloween!!
m400582.だったら話は簡単ね！\nみんなまとめて倒して、それから保護するわよ！:
Then the solution is simple!
We take them all down, and then we protect the survivors!
m400582.でしたら、今から見に行きましょうか。\nちょうどハロウィンが始まる時間です。\n:
Then, let's go take a look.
It's just about time for Halloween to start.
Look, beyond the window, the villagers are enjoying the festivities……
m400582.とはいえ、ハロウィン会場には人が大勢集まっており、\n普段のような部隊展開を行う:
That said, since a large crowd has gathered at the Halloween venue,
it will be difficult to deploy units as usual.
m400582.な、なんですかコイツら！？\nチェーンソーを持った怪物たちが、\n会場を練り歩い:
W-what are those things?!
Monsters wielding chainsaws are
wandering through the venue...!?
m400582.なにが起こるか分からない状況のため、\nこちらも万全の準備をして臨みましょう。:
Given the unpredictable situation,
we must prepare thoroughly before we proceed.
m400582.なんか変なのいませんでした？？？: Wasn't there something weird going on just now???
m400582.なんにせよ、この騒動をどうにかしないと、\nハロウィンを楽しめないわよ！\nさっ:
Regardless, we have to deal with this commotion,
or we won't be able to enjoy Halloween!
Let's go, Prince!
m400582.ふふっ。ハロウィンに相応しい、楽しい催しじゃない。\nそれなら王子くんたちと手合:
Fufu. A fun event that's perfectly suited for Halloween.
In that case, let's have a little match with the Prince and his friends♪
m400582.ほ、本当！？ 何回も練習し――こほんっ！\n私は手先だって器用なんだから、あれく:
R-Really?! I practiced so many times, but― cough!
I'm quite dexterous with my hands, you know. That was a piece of cake for me!
m400582.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを\n入手出来ない点にも気を付けて下さい。:
Also, please be aware that you will not gain any EXP or Gold
from defeating enemies.
m400582.みんな仮装して楽しそうじゃない！\n私たち、一歩遅れちゃったわね！:
Everyone is costumed up and having so much fun!
We must have arrived just a little too late!
m400582.もうすっごいんだから！\n王子にも今すぐ見てもらいたいくらい！:
They did an amazing job!
I want the Prince to see them right now!
m400582.もちろん私も手伝うわよ。\nお姉ちゃんに任せてね。:
Of course, I'll help too.
Leave it to your big sister.
m400582.よしっ！ これで少しは静かに……。: Good! Now things will be a bit quieter...
m400582.んん？ 王子たちがいるってことは……分かったわ！\nこれはきっと模擬戦ね！:
Hm? If the Prince is here, then... I get it!
This must be a sparring match!
m400582.アンデッドたちが襲ってきます……！？\nちくしょう！ とんだハロウィンですよ！！:
The undead are attacking…!?
Damn it! What a Halloween this is turning out to be!!
--- scene: Divine Rank (battle, end) ---
m400582.ウッヒョーッ！ 暴走したぜッ！！\n腕も４本に増えてチェーンソーもご機嫌だッ！:
WHEEE! I'm going wild!!
I've got four arms now, and the chainsaws are in a great mood!
m400582.キエェェ―！ トリック・オア・ローキック！\nトリック・オア・ローキック！\n執:
Halloween Brainwashed Villager B: Kyeee—! Trick or treat, low kick!
Trick or treat, low kick!
I'm going to keep hammering those knees!
m400582.ケヒャァー！！\nトリック・オア・疾風の翼！\nトリック・オア・疾風の翼ァ！:
Kyahh!!
Trick or Treat, Wings of the Gale!
Trick or Treat, Wings of the Gale!
m400582.チェインソン男が倒れたことで、\n皆さんの精神支配も解けたようですわね。:
Now that Chainson Man has been defeated,
it seems everyone's minds have been freed from his control.
m400582.チェインソン男だかなんだか知らないけど、\nよくも祝祭をめちゃくちゃにしてくれた:
I don't care what you call yourselves,
but you really shouldn't have wrecked the festival!
We all worked so hard to prepare for it!
m400582.チェーンソッソッソォ！！\nいや……それに関しては本当にごめんって……。\n暴動:
Chainso-so-so—!
Ah... I'm really sorry about that...
Once the riot is over, I'll help you fix everything...
m400582.ハロウィン会場からの報告によると、\nチェーンソーを振り回している怪物だけでなく:
Reports from the Halloween venue indicate that, in addition to the monsters
wielding chainsaws, there are also costumed villagers and the undead
gathering there.
m400582.ヒャッハー！ トリック・オア・右フック！\nトリック・オア・右フックゥ！\nどう:
Halloween Brainwashed Villager A: Hyah-hah! Trick or treat, right hook!
Trick or treat, right hook!
How's that? Your body's taking some real damage, isn't it!
m400582.ビジュアルもカッコよくなっちまったなァ！\nこれで次の人気闘兵１位は俺のモンだぜ:
My look is way cooler now, too!
I'm definitely going to be the top popular fighter next time!
m400582.一緒にハロウィンの仮装をしたから分かるわ！\nあなたなら絶対に大丈夫よ！:
I know because we dressed up for Halloween together!
You'll be absolutely fine!
m400582.今日に向けて衣裳も用意して、\n村の人たちと会場の飾りつけも頑張ったわ。\nきっ:
I prepared the costumes for today, and I really worked hard on decorating the venue with the villagers.
I'm sure it's going to be a wonderful Halloween♪
m400582.今日のアンナさんは何を言っているんですか！？: What are you talking about, Anna?!
m400582.俺たちはハロウィンでパワーアップしたアンデッド！\nチェインソン男とでも呼んでく:
We are the undead, powered up by Halloween!
Call us the Chainson Men, if you like!
Sorry, but this festival is going to be a festival of violence!!
m400582.俺たちもやるぜ！\n村人の力を見せてやらァーー！！:
We're in too!
Let's show you the strength of the villagers!!
m400582.出撃されるのですね、王子。\nですがその前に、今回のミッションは、\n敵の討伐を:
Very well, Prince. You are deploying.
However, before that, please note that this operation is a
"Grand Cull Mission," aimed at eliminating the enemies.
m400582.出撃コストが時間経過では回復しないため、\nスキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、:
Because deployment cost does not recover over time,
I recommend including members with the "Reinforcement Request" skill,
or Valkyries, in your formation.
m400582.名案じゃない！ お詫びもかねて、全力で頑張るわ！: That's a great idea! As an apology, I'll give it my all!
m400582.嘘でしょ……きゃぁーー！？\n頑張って作った飾りつけが破壊されてるじゃない！？:
No way…… Aaaah!?
They're destroying the decorations I worked so hard on!?
m400582.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、:
Even if the base's life reaches zero,
the number of enemies defeated up to that point will be recorded,
so do not fear falling; stand against the enemy.
m400582.王子殿下、大変なハロウィンでしたから、\nあとでいっぱい、埋め合わせをしてくださ:
Your Highness, it was quite a chaotic Halloween.
I'll make it up to you later, so just wait.
m400582.現状は……バリケードを設置して凌いでいるようですね。\nですが外側に仮装した村人:
It seems they are currently holding their ground behind barricades.
However, there are costumed villagers on the outside,
making it impossible to distinguish them from the undead.
m400582.痛っ！ やめ……上等だァァーー！！\nそんなにハロウィンしたいならお菓子をくれて:
Ow! Stop... Fine, I'm done holding back!!
If you want Halloween so badly, I'll give you some candy!
But it's gonna taste like your blood, you hear me!!
m400582.窓から見える範囲で、暴れているのは……。\n怪物の仮面を被っている村人……！？\:
From what I can see out the window, the ones rampaging are……
Villagers wearing monster masks……!?
What on earth is happening…….
m400582.細かいことはいいじゃない！\nみんなでハロウィンを楽しみましょう！:
Who cares about the details!
Let's all enjoy Halloween!
m400582.通りすがりのシャルロットさん！！: Charlotte, who just happened to be passing by!!
m400582.闇夜の時間が近づいているおかげで、\nアンデッドたちの動きも活発になってるぜ！\:
Now that night is falling,
the undead are getting more active!
Let's go, everyone! It's Halloween time!

m500401.――さて、報告は以上だけど、\n王子にはもうひとつ仕事が残っているぞ。:
――Well, that concludes the report, but
you have one more task to do, Prince.
m500401.――失礼します。\n魔界戦線のご報告です。:
――Pardon the intrusion.
I have a report on the situation at the Demon Realm front.
m500401.――止めるのが一歩遅かったな。\n王子は乗り気みたいだぞ？:
――Too late to stop him.
It looks like the Prince is up for it?
m500401.――王子、来てくれたか。\nだが戦況は最悪だ。\n魔神の侵攻を遅らせることすらで:
――Prince, you came.
But the situation is dire.
We can't even slow the Demon Gods' advance.
m500401.――王子、気をつけろ！\n魔神アモンの魔力が増幅しているぞ！:
――Prince, be careful!
The Demon God Amon's magic power is amplifying!
m500401.……ただ、暴走の原因は不明なままです。\n今後も調査が必要ですね。:
……However, the cause of the berserk state remains unknown.
Further investigation will be necessary.
m500401.……はぁ、分かってないって顔だね。\nあの強力な魔神を、同時に２体も討伐したんだ:
……Sigh, you look like you don't get it.
You defeated two powerful Demon Gods at the same time, you know?
m500401.……はぁ。\n王子、くれぐれも身体を壊さない程度でお願いしますね？:
……Sigh.
Prince, please be careful not to overdo it and make yourself sick, okay?
m500401.……やれやれ、今度こそ決着か？: ……Well, well. Is this finally the end?
m500401.……答えを聞くまでもなさそう、ですね。\n魔界には私たちの仲間も大勢います。\n:
……I don't think we need to ask for your answer.
We have many comrades in the Demon Realm as well.
We must stop the Demon Gods' assault!
m500401.あ、あの……王子は遠征から戻った直後で、\nそれに魔界でも飲み明かしてきたばかり:
Ah, um…… the Prince has just returned from the expedition,
and he also just finished drinking all night in the Demon Realm――
m500401.ああ。王子、危険な作戦になるとは承知している。\nだがどうか、力を貸してほしい。:
Yes. Prince, I know this will be a dangerous operation.
But please, lend us your strength.
m500401.ああ。魔神ほどの強靭な器が、\n吹き飛ぶほどの魔力が貯蔵されたなら、\n魔界など:
Yes. If a vessel as sturdy as a Demon God
were to store enough magic power to blow itself apart,
the resulting force would be enough to obliterate the Demon Realm.
m500401.あの後、キメリエス、アモン共に、\n復活する様子はまったく見られない。:
After that, there were no signs whatsoever
of either Kimeres or Amon reviving.
m500401.うぅぅ～……。\nいやーな感じ……ぎりぎり爆発してないっていうか、\nもういつ弾:
Uuuu……
It feels awful…… like it's on the verge of exploding,
and it could blow apart at any moment……
m500401.このまま無尽蔵に魔力を溜め込めば、\nいずれ、遠くないタイミングで……。:
If they keep hoarding magic power without limit,
before long, at some point soon……
m500401.これなるは神に至る試練を超越せしもの。: This is the transcendence of the trial that leads to godhood.
m500401.これは……！\nアモンが周囲に展開していた、\n生命力を削る力が戦場全域に広がっ:
This is……!
The power Amon was projecting around him,
which drains life force, is spreading across the entire battlefield!
m500401.これまでと同じ、とは思わないほうがいいな。\nこの異常な魔力量だ、己の消滅を厭わ:
I wouldn't count on this being the same as before.
With that abnormal amount of magic power, they might unleash a force that doesn't even care about their own annihilation.
m500401.せっかく魔界に来たんだ。\nついでに戦った者たちをねぎらってやってくれないか？:
Since we've come all the way to the Demon Realm,
wouldn't you like to take a moment to commend those who fought?
m500401.そしてそれが２体同時。\n……被害予想は、不可能ですね。:
And that would happen to two of them at once.
……Estimating the damage is impossible.
m500401.その魔神に対して、人類が一矢報いたのです。\n誰もがあなたの言葉を聞きたがってい:

But!

Belladonna, it is the ritual for you to become the lord.

I'll show you just how impenetrable Belart Fortress is,

To name a fortress after yourself…

(Lady Angeline,

Since it's a rabbit, I imagined a cute girl like Shushu, but……

doesn't it possess the power of the "Divine Radiance"?

Oh, the size here seems off too!
Alright, how about this? Squeeze!

Huh……?
Isn't that the same outfit the Jade Rabbit was wearing?
m900380.いえ、メイドたるもの、\n公然の場でご主人様に抱きつくわけには――: No, a maid cannot simply embrace her master in public――

There's a bunny
coming to see you♪

If the Jade Rabbit is defeated,
it stops healing and buffing, and sometimes turns violent……
m900380.えっ……神獣の衣装貰っちゃったんですか！？: Ehh…… you got the Divine Beast's outfit?

Isn't this the mode from the legends,

will surely be a cute, bouncy, rabbit-filled affair――

I wasn't being sarcastic, so

m900380.祝祭の伝統を忘れられてしまった、\n可哀想な神獣さま、か。\nせめて僕らで、奉納:

Now I can command the shadows of monsters…
Ha… Hahaha, hahahaha…
m920038.これ以上あの危険な石を使わせるわけには\nいきません。: We can't let her keep using that dangerous stone.
m920038.ご、ごせん……。\n相変わらず常識離れした攻撃力ですね……。\n上位のデーモンと: G-gosh… Your attack power is still absurdly out of common sense… No wonder you're a higher-ranking demon.
m920038.さぁ、賢者の石よ。\n再び我らにその力を貸すのだ……！:
Now, Philosopher's Stone.
Lend us your power once more…!
m920038.そうだね。その石の力を使いこなせば\n君の望む真理を見ることができるさ。: Indeed. Master its power and you'll witness the truth you seek.
m920038.だが、王子よ。お前の存在が邪魔だ。\n私の願いのためにも、倒させていただく。:
But, Prince, your very existence stands in my way.
For the sake of my wish, I shall defeat you.
m920038.だが「あのお方」に譲り受けたこの力……。\n素晴らしい……。\nこれさえあれば真:
But this power I inherited from “that one”…
Magnificent…
With this, the day I see the truth draws near…
m920038.どうやら本来の彼女に戻ったようです。\n安心しました……。: It seems she's returned to her original self. I'm relieved…
m920038.どうやら私の手には負えないみたいだね。\nならば、あのお方に直接戦ってもらおうか: Looks like it's beyond my ability now. Then I'll have that one fight for me… Come on, chase them!
m920038.なぜ王国を実験場にしようと……？: Why would you turn the kingdom into a testing ground…?
m920038.ふふふ、しつこい奴らだね。\nもしかして私が欲しいのかい……\n私に勝てたら考え:
Heh, they're so persistent.
You want me, don't you…?
If you can beat me, I'll consider it.
m920038.ふむ……。もう会話もできないか。\n自我を失いかけてるみたいだね。:
Hmm… You can barely speak now.
Looks like you're losing your sense of self.
m920038.また防御力を……！\n王子、お気を付けください！:
Our defenses are dropping again…!
Prince, be careful!
m920038.ククク……。さすがは私だ……。\nこれなら人間を操ることができる……。: Heh heh… As expected of me… With this, I can control humans…
m920038.クククク……分かったぞ……。\n賢者の石の更なる力を発揮する方法が……！:
Hehehe… I understand now…
The method to unleash even greater power of the Stone…!
m920038.コリンさん、どうかお止めください！\nこれ以上はあなたにも何が起こるか……！: Corin, please stop! If you keep going, something will happen to you too…!
m920038.コリンよ。賢者の石を上手く\n使いこなせているようだね。: Corin. It seems you're handling the Philosopher's Stone quite well.
m920038.チッ……。\nそう簡単にはいかないか。:
Tch…
It won't be that easy.
m920038.ワシの攻撃力は5000だ。\nどうだ、絶望しただろう？。\nさぁ一人ずつ粉砕して: My attack power is 5,000. How's that, feeling despair yet? I'll crush you one by one.
m920038.情けないものだな。\n真理を求めて事を起こしたのに……。\n賢者の石も、私の手に: Pathetic. I set out seeking truth, yet… the Philosopher's Stone didn't stay in my hands.
m920038.来たか。お前が王子だな。\n私はコリン……。\nそう、コリンだ。:
So you've arrived. You must be the Prince.
I am Corin… Yes, Corin.
m920038.森に住む者たちがこの周囲で\n逃げていく魔女を見たという話ですが…\nあの小屋が: The forest dwellers say they've seen the witch fleeing around here… Could that hut be her hideout?
m920038.気を付けてください。\nこの神殿を覆っている霧は\n癒しの力を妨げています。: Please be careful. The mist covering this temple hinders healing.
m920038.王子、ここが正念場です。\nあのデーモンをたおすことができれば\nコリンさんを解: Prince, this is the critical moment. If we can take down that demon, we should be able to free Corin.
m920038.王子、どうやら報告にあったアルケミストが\nいるのはここのようです。: Prince, it seems the alchemist mentioned in the report is here.
m920038.王子、魔女はあの穴に逃げ込んだようです。\n何が潜んでいるかわかりません。\nお: Prince, the witch has fled into that hole. We don't know what's lurking there. Please be careful.
m920038.王子、魔物たちの襲撃です。\n女神様の神殿を狙っているようです。\n迎え撃ちまし: Prince, the monsters are attacking. They seem to be targeting the goddess's temple. Let's meet them head-on.
m920038.王子たちにも迷惑をかけた。すまないな。\n改めて、私はアルケミストのコリン。\n: I caused trouble for you princes as well. I'm sorry. Let me reintroduce myself: I'm Corin the Alchemist. If we meet again, remember me.
m920038.王子の兵士すら……、\n我ら、の……操り人形だ……。: Even the Prince's soldiers… are… our puppets…
m920038.真理を見たい……。\nそのためなら私はどうなっても……。:
I want to see the truth…
For that, I'll become anything…
m920038.真理を見たい……。\n真理……真理を……。:
I want to see the truth…
Truth… truth…
m920038.私は錬金術によって、この世の真理を見たい。\nそのためにはこの賢者の石を使い\n:
Through alchemy I seek to glimpse the truth of this world.
To that end I must use the Philosopher's Stone and make this country my laboratory.
m920038.賢者の石……！？\nもし彼女の言葉通りだとしたら\n王子、ここは慎重に行きましょ:
The Philosopher's Stone…!?
If her words are true, Prince, we must proceed with caution!

m920046.あたしだってそうですよ！ 特訓で\n遠くの敵を狙えるようになったんです！: Same for me! The training let me target distant enemies!
m920046.ここまでくるなんてすごいじゃない。\n私が「拡散弾」を扱えるようになったのも\n: It's amazing you've made it this far. I was able to handle "scatter shots" thanks to the special training. Keep it up.
m920046.こちらでは、隊列を組んで進軍して頂きます。\n統率された行動を取るための演習です:
Here you'll march in formation.
It's an exercise in coordinated action.
m920046.この演習場は砂漠地帯となります。\n砂漠では出撃の際に体力が減少します。\nこの: This training ground is a desert area. In the desert, your stamina will decrease when you deploy. Remember that trait well.
m920046.さっきは助かったわ。迷惑かけて悪かったわね。\n私はカノン。あの場所で砲術士を目: Thanks for saving me earlier. Sorry for the trouble. I'm Kanon. I was training on my own at that place, aiming to become an artillery specialist.
m920046.せっかくですからお二人も特訓に\n参加されてはいかがですか？: Since you're here, why don't you both join the special training?
m920046.その方が、一人のときよりも楽しく\n学ぶことが出来るでしょう。: That way, it'll be more fun than training alone, and you'll learn more.
m920046.それでは、演習場に参りましょう。: Then, let's head to the training grounds.
m920046.それに、やっぱり仲間と一緒だと\n心強いわね。: And, of course, it's reassuring to have comrades by your side.
m920046.だからお願い。\nどうか私の訓練を手伝ってもらえないかしら。王子。: So please. Could you help me with my training, Prince?
m920046.どうやらここが魔物が出現した場所の\nようですが……。: It seems this is where the monsters emerged….
m920046.なんとか収まりましたね。\nひとまず戻りましょうか。:
Looks like it settled down.
Let's head back for now.
m920046.まずはここでの訓練から始めましょう。\nこの一帯は王城にほど近い田園地帯です。:
First, let's start training here.
This area is a rural region close to the royal capital.
m920046.よし！ なんとか倒せたわ。: Alright! We managed to take it down.
m920046.わかった！ やってみるわ！\n特訓、よろしくお願いします！:
Got it! I'll give it a try!
Looking forward to the special training!
m920046.カノンさんは、敵の移動速度を下げる\n砲弾をお持ちのようですね。\n使ってみるの:
Kanon, you seem to have shells that can slow enemy movement.
It might be worth trying them out.
m920046.今回は、機動力が大幅にアップする坂道の\n地形を活かす演習を行います。: This time we'll practice using the sloped terrain that greatly boosts mobility.
m920046.以前はちゃんとした砲術士の学校に通っていたんだけど、\n魔物が現れて学校は破壊さ: I used to attend a proper artillery school, but monsters appeared and the school was destroyed…
m920046.元士官学校のみんなも一緒なんだから\n絶対に負けたくない。\n特訓の成果を出し切: Everyone from the former officer school is here too, so I absolutely won't lose. I'll give it my all!
m920046.弱いから大事なものを守れなかった。\nもうあんな後悔はしたくない。\n自分のせい: We were weak and couldn't protect what mattered. I don't want to feel that regret again. I won't stand by and watch someone die because of me!
m920046.彼女は……？\nあの、どうかされましたか！？:
Who is she…?
Um, are you alright!?
m920046.授業で習ったことがある。たしかこの地形は\n攻める側にとって有利なのよね。\n実:
I learned this in class. This kind of terrain definitely favors the attacker.
It's a chance to test it in a real fight.
m920046.攻撃のタイミングをあわせることにも繋がるので\nとても大事ですよ。: It's crucial, since it helps us synchronize our attack timing—very important.
m920046.次からは、王子軍がお相手させていただきます。\nカノンさん側にも、王子軍から生え:
From now on, the Prince's forces will take over.
We've also prepared fresh soldiers from the Prince's army for your side, Kanon.
m920046.王子、このままでは彼女も危ないです。\n魔物を倒しつつ、彼女の動きを止めましょう: Prince, if we don't act, she'll be in danger too. Let's defeat the monsters and halt her cannon!
m920046.私だって少しは上達したはず……。\nやってやるわ！: I've improved a bit too... I'll show them!
m920046.私の持ってる大砲が暴走しちゃって……っ！\n暴発を止めてほしいの……！: My cannon went berserk…! I need someone to stop the misfire…!
m920046.隊列を組んで迎え撃つのも\n砲兵における戦術の一つって\n先生が言ってた気がする: I think the teacher mentioned that forming a line to meet the enemy is also a tactic for artillery.
m920046.魔物が現れたときに私たちをかばって助けてくれた先生や\n先輩たちの背中。仲間と森: When the monsters showed up, the teachers and seniors who protected us… We fled into the forest with our comrades and shivered for three days and nights…

m920071.――うッ、くぅぅッ……！\nまた、やられちゃうなんて……くやしいよぉー！: —Ugh, ugh…! To be taken down again… so frustrating!
m920071.――ぐァッ……はぁ、はぁ……。\nこ、これでも勝てぬとは……王子め……。\nその: —Gah… huff, huff… Even now I can't win… Prince… That spirit of yours… you truly are a hero…
m920071.――カッカッカ……妖虎仙よ。\nしつけを誤ったのぅ。\n虎姫めが全てをばらしてし: —Kakkakka… Youkosen. You've been mis-trained. The Tiger Princess has spilled everything…
m920071.――グルルル……。\n街へは向かわせん。\nこれ以上、妖虎仙様の邪魔はさせぬぞ！: ――Grrr… I won't let you head to the town. I won't let you hinder Lord Yōko any longer!
m920071.――何をきょろきょろしておる人間ども。\nわしを探しておるのかな？: —What are you humans staring at? Looking for me, perhaps?
m920071.…………ま、まさか、\n私達が街に来る前に出会っていた\nあのお爺さんが邪仙郷の: …I can't believe… that the old man we met before coming to town was actually one of the Jasenkyō….
m920071.……あ、ありがとう。\nメイリンなんかの為に……駆けつけてくれて。\n本当に、あ: …Th-thank you. Thank you for rushing here for someone like me. Really, thank you….
m920071.……あ、それで、\nメイリンからのお願いなんだけど……。\nこれからも、ここにい: …Right, there's something I want to ask… I'd like to stay here from now on…
m920071.……うぉぉぉおおおッ！！！\nこれだ、これこそが魔神ウェパルの力だ……。\n貴様: …Whoa!!! This is it, the true power of Wepal… Can you feel it, this terrible power!
m920071.……うん。もう大丈夫。\nちゃんと落ち着いたし、自己紹介できるよ。\n王子、わた: …Yeah. I'm fine now. I've calmed down and can introduce myself properly. Prince, my name's Meiling!
m920071.……え！ いいの！？\nわーい！！ ありがとう！ 王子！\nメイリン、精一杯頑張: …What! It's okay!? Yay!! Thank you, Prince! I'll do my best!
m920071.……おい、あの女の子を\nこのまま行かせていいのか？ \nもしかしたら操られてる: …Hey, should we just let that girl go? She might be being controlled…
m920071.……ぐ、うぅ……し、屍解仙め……。\nこれが貴様の……邪仙郷の奴らのねらい、か…: …Guh, ugh… You… Shikai-sen… Is this… the goal of those from Jasenkyō…? Meiling… run… you… only…
m920071.……ちィッ！？ なかなかどうしてやりよるわい。\n虎姫め、新しいキョンシーの製作: …What the—!? You're putting up quite a fight. Tiger Princess, you would have made perfect material for a new Jiangshi…
m920071.……どうやらメイリンさんも一緒のようですね。\n王子、妖虎仙の居場所までもう少し: …Looks like Meiling's with us too. Prince, we're almost at Youkosen's location! Let's win this battle no matter what!
m920071.……ま、待ってよ！\n父様にはもう戦う力なんて無いんだ……。\nお願いだから命ま: …Wait! Father has no strength left to fight… Please, don't take his life!
m920071.……まさかこれほどまでの\n力を持っているとは。\nどうやら目算を誤まっていたよ: …I never imagined you possessed such power. It seems we miscalculated…
m920071.……む？\n向こうから何者かがやってくるようじゃのぉ。\n……なるほど人間か。こ: …Hmm? Looks like someone's coming from over there. …Ah, humans. This is just the right opportunity.
m920071.……よかろう。\nだが、次は無いぞ……。\nメイリンよ、早う立て。退くぞ。: …Very well. But there will be no next time… Meiling, rise at once. Withdraw.
m920071.……んふぉぉぉおおおっ！ 感じますッ！\nあらゆるものを蝕もうとする恐ろしい力が: …Nn-ooo! I feel it! A terrifying power that devours everything!
m920071.……キョンシーとは、死んだ人間を\n妖術によって使役しているものです……。\n死:
…Jiangshi are the dead, controlled by sorcery…
It's a forbidden external art that toys with the souls of the dead!
m920071.……何か対策が必要かも知れませんね。\n王子をお護りする為にも、引き続き\n妖怪: …We may need a countermeasure. To protect the Prince, let's keep a close eye on the youkai's activities.
m920071.……機、いよいよ熟せり……。\n我が妖術の奥義……使うは今ぞッ！\nはぁぁぁアア: …Now, at last… the ultimate of my demonic arts… now is the time! Haaaa Aaaahhh――!
m920071.……王子がメイリンの父様を\nイジメルのがいけないんだ！: …It's wrong for the Prince to bully my father!
m920071.……色々と話を聞きたかったのですが、\nまた逃げられてしまいましたね。: …I wanted to ask you a lot of things, but you ran off again.
m920071.「アンデッド」という事ですね……。\n死者を弄ぶとは……なんて、ひどいことを……:
So they're “undead”… To toy with the dead… How horrible…
Is there no way to save them?
m920071.あ、あれは！？\n妖虎と一緒にいた女の子……！: Ah, what's that!? A girl with the Yōko…!
m920071.ああ、しかとこの目でな。\n……なるほど、どうやら本当に\n妖虎仙を追う者たちと: ???: Ah, with my own eyes. …I see, so you truly are the ones hunting Youkosen.
m920071.ああ、そうだ。\n其方の父君の名誉のためにも、\nここで王子たちを倒すのだ！: Yes, exactly. For your father's honor, we'll take down the Prince here!
m920071.あなたはいったい……。\nいえ、それよりも妖虎仙を見かけたのですか？: Who are you…? No, more importantly, did you see Youkosen?
m920071.あの道の先に妖虎仙に滅ぼされた街がある。\nそこが妖虎仙の領地となっているのじゃ: ???: Beyond that road lies the town destroyed by Youkosen. That's his domain… If you go, be careful.
m920071.あれが父様を苦しめてる悪い奴か……。\n王子を倒せば、父様がアイツらから\n悪口: So those are the ones tormenting my father… If we defeat the Prince, my dad won't have to endure their insults, right?
m920071.い、痛い！！\n手を放して！\nもうメイリンは邪仙郷の人達と関わりたくないの！: It hurts!! Let go of me! I don't want anything to do with the people of Jasenkyō anymore!
m920071.いえ、そんなことよりも気をつけてください！\nキョンシーは一筋縄ではいかない魔物:
No, more importantly, be careful!
Jiangshi aren't monsters you can deal with easily!
m920071.いえいえ！ メイリンさんは大事な仲間ですから。\nさぁ、皆さんそれでは帰還しまし: No, no! Meiling is an important comrade. Now, everyone, let's return. Thank you all for your hard work in this battle.
m920071.いつも素っ気なかったけど、\nちゃんとメイリンの事を想ってくれてたんだって分かっ: He was always distant, but I realized he really cared about me, and just the memories of him are enough for me to keep living!
m920071.うるさい、うるさい、うるさーいっ！\n絶対に王子を倒してみせるからな！\n首を洗: Shut up, shut up, shut—! I'll definitely defeat the Prince! Just wait for his head to roll!
m920071.お、お前は……妖怪総大将ぬらりひょん！？\nなぜこんなところに……！: Y-you're… the Grand General of youkai, Nurarihyon!? Why are you here…!
m920071.おい、また逃げるのか、屍解仙！？\n最後まで戦えってんだ！\n……くそ、見失っち: Hey, running away again, Shikai-sen!? Fight till the end! …Damn, I've lost sight of you.
m920071.おおおっ！？\nで……やはり、拙者らも飲むのですか？: Whoa!? So… we're supposed to drink it too?
m920071.おんのれぇ……っ。貴様らぁ！\nわしの苦労を水の泡にしよって……。\nいつか必ず: Damn… you! Throwing my hard work away… I'll make you see something someday!
m920071.お爺さん、これより私達は街に向かいます。\n帰途に不安があれば、\n護衛をつけま:
Grandpa, from here we'll head to the town.
If you're uneasy on the way back, we can assign a guard—what do you think?
m920071.ここは一度退くぞ、虎姫！: Let's retreat for now, Tiger Princess.
m920071.ここは一旦退くしかあるまい……さらばじゃ。: I guess I'll have to retreat for now… Farewell.
m920071.この区域で出現報告のあった魔物も\n何とか討伐できたようですね。\nそれでは王子: It seems we've dealt with the monsters reported in this area. Then, Prince, let's return.
m920071.この街を滅ぼして己の領地とした\n妖虎仙の仕業とみて間違いないと思います。: I'm pretty sure this is the work of the demon-tiger spirit who destroyed the town and claimed it as his domain.
m920071.これで彼らの魂も、\n術者の妖術の拘束から解放されることでしょう。\n本当に、よ: Now their souls should be freed from the sorcerer's cursed magic. I'm really glad…
m920071.これは礼を失したのぅ……。\nなぁに、妖虎仙の力の強大さに感嘆したのじゃよ。\n: How rude of me… Well, I was merely awed by Youkosen's overwhelming power. …Now, look, Tiger Princess. It seems the Prince has finally arrived, hasn't he?
m920071.これを煎じて飲めば、\n魔神ウェパルの力が手にはいるのだ！: If we brew and drink this, we'll gain Wepal's power!
m920071.これ以上無闇に進んでも意味が\nありませんね……どうしたらいいのでしょうか。: There's no point in forging ahead blindly… What should we do?
m920071.ごめんなさい、父様……。\nでも王子を倒さないと、またアイツらに悪口を\n言われ: I'm sorry, Father… But if we don't defeat the Prince, they'll keep bad-mouthing us and it'll be miserable, right? So…
m920071.さっきよりもいっぱい妖虎たちを\n連れてきたんだから、もう負けないぞぉ！！: I've brought even more Yōko this time, so I won't lose now!!
m920071.さっそく魔物が現れたようですね。\n王子、戦いの準備をお願いします！: Looks like the monster's already shown up. Prince, please prepare for battle!
m920071.さて、一先ずの膳立ては済んだようじゃな。\nこれで戦う意思に火がついたじゃろうて:
Well, the preparations are done for now.
That should have sparked your will to fight…
…I'm looking forward to see how it turns out.
m920071.さて、今日はお前を迎えにきたのじゃ、虎姫。\n仙人の才能のないお前でも役に立てる: Well then, I've come to fetch you today, Tiger Princess. Even someone without any immortal talent like you can be useful… Come this way!
m920071.し、信じられん……。\n新たに仲間にした妖怪たちが\n全員やられてしまうとは……: I… can't believe it… All the youkai I just recruited have been wiped out…!?
m920071.そ、そんなぁ……。\nいっぱい妖虎たちを連れてきたのに、\nまた負けちゃったよぉ: N-no… I brought so many Yōko, and we lost again…
m920071.そうですね……。\n王子、彼女たちを追いかけましょう！: That's true… Prince, let's chase after them!
m920071.そうは言うがな……ぬしも王子たちがすぐそこまで\n来ているのを感じ取っておるのじ: You say that, but you can feel the Prince is almost upon us, can't you? If you die before the chance matures, it'll be all for nothing.
m920071.それにしても、なんて酷い有り様でしょう。\n魔物がこんなに沢山……。\nあ、あそ:
But look at this terrible state.
So many monsters…
Ah, there seem to be people over there, Prince!
